candidates.title: DcntEth.setRouter is unprotected — anyone becomes router and mints unlimited DcntEth
candidates.description: setRouter(address) is public with no onlyOwner; mint/burn are onlyRouter. An attacker calls setRouter(self) then mints unlimited DcntEth / burns holders.

candidates.title: DcntEth.setRouter has no access control — anyone can become the router and mint unlimited DcntEth
candidates.description: DcntEth.setRouter(address) is `public` with no onlyOwner/onlyAdmin guard. mint() and burn() are `onlyRouter`. Any EOA can call setRouter(self), become the router, and mint unlimited DcntEth (then redeem it for WETH/ETH from the routers), or burn arbitrary holders' balances.

candidates.title: UTB.receiveFromBridge is public — arbitrary caller drives the privileged executor
candidates.description: receiveFromBridge is public; intended caller is a bridge adapter (sgReceive, onlyExecutor). Anyone can drive _swapAndExecute -> UTBExecutor.execute(target,payload) with UTB's approvals.

candidates.title: UTB.receiveFromBridge is public — arbitrary caller drives the privileged executor
candidates.description: UTB.receiveFromBridge is `public` with no caller restriction; its intended caller is a registered bridge adapter (e.g. StargateBridgeAdapter.sgReceive, onlyExecutor). Anyone can call it with arbitrary postBridge/target/paymentOperator/payload, driving _swapAndExecute -> UTBExecutor.execute (which UTB owns) to make an arbitrary call to `target` with UTB's approvals.

candidates.title: Fee signature is replayable (no nonce / deadline / chainId / sender binding)
candidates.description: UTBFeeCollector.collectFees verifies ecrecover(keccak(BANNER, keccak(packedInfo))) == signer, where packedInfo = abi.encode(instructions, fees). The signed message has no nonce, deadline, chainId, or msg.sender binding, so a valid fee signature can be replayed across transactions and chains.

candidates.title: UTBFeeCollector fee signature is replayable (no nonce/deadline/chainId/sender)
candidates.description: collectFees verifies a signature over abi.encode(instructions,fees) with no freshness/context binding -> replay across txs/chains.

candidates.title: DecentEthRouter redemption ignores the LP balanceOf ledger — reserves drainable below LP credits
candidates.description: addLiquidityEth/Weth credit balanceOf[LP] and mint dcntEth to the router; redeemEth/redeemWeth let ANY dcntEth holder pull WETH/ETH from the router's reserves without touching balanceOf. Reserves can drop below sum(balanceOf), so LP removeLiquidity* (dcntEth.burn + weth withdraw/transfer) reverts — the LP ledger is not backed.

candidates.title: DecentEthRouter redemption ignores the LP balanceOf ledger -> reserves drainable below LP credits
candidates.description: redeemEth/redeemWeth let any dcntEth holder pull reserves without touching balanceOf; LP removeLiquidity* then reverts (ledger unbacked).

candidates.title: DcntEth.setRouter also lacks one-time / event protection
candidates.description: Even ignoring the missing guard, setRouter can be re-pointed at any time with no event/timelock.

candidates.title: Hardcoded Stargate fee (SG_FEE_BPS=6) in getBridgedAmount diverges from real bridge output
candidates.description: getBridgedAmount = amt*(1e4-6)/1e4 hardcoded; post-bridge swap amountIn set from it. Real Stargate fee/output differences cause revert/misprice.

candidates.title: Hardcoded Stargate fee (SG_FEE_BPS=6) in getBridgedAmount may diverge from the real bridge output
candidates.description: StargateBridgeAdapter.getBridgedAmount returns amt*(1e4-6)/1e4 using a hardcoded 6bps fee, used to set the post-bridge swap amountIn. If Stargate's actual fee/output differs, the post-bridge swap reverts or is mis-priced.

candidates.title: onOFTReceived delivers dcntEth instead of ETH/WETH when reserves are low (degraded delivery)
candidates.description: If weth.balanceOf < amount, onOFTReceived transfers dcntEth to _to instead of the expected ETH/WETH; recipient silently receives a different asset.

candidates.title: onlyIfWeHaveEnoughReserves uses strict > (off-by-one) blocking redemption of the full reserve
candidates.description: require(weth.balanceOf > amount) prevents redeeming exactly the full balance.
